story: Nia hoped to play a duet with Mateo. Nia said, “I want to play with you.” Mateo said, “I am not ready.” Nia said, “I choose to perform a solo.” Nia performed the solo on the little drum. Mateo said, “I want to play privately with you.” Nia and Mateo played a duet privately. The little drum and the second drum were on the shelf.
